what: Two sets (a and b) of small photo slots placed between the words of the big title expand and fold in turn. The expanding slot widens at once over 1s and its photo opens from the center .2s later, while the folding slot’s photo pinches to the center and the width closes .4s later (cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). It switches every 8.5s only while visible, and pressing the dotted-circle button switches immediately while the button spins in four beats for 1 second. Both start expanded, then b folds when first seen · look: stack has two photos overlapped in one spot that open alternately in .5s

options.every: Auto-advance interval (seconds), default 8.5 — 0 means buttons only
options.lock: Time (sec) the button spins and can’t be changed again after switching, default 1
options.look: stack — two cells overlap in one spot and only the photos open in turn (.5s ease)
options.--fx-w: Photo cell width, default 1.125em (scales with font size)
options.--fx-gap: Side margin of the expanded cell, default .1875em
options.--fx-rest-gap: Side margin kept on a collapsed column, default 0 — use on columns where two words would touch (first line a in the original)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-open-delay · --fx-close-: Transition length 1s · open delay .2s · close delay .4s
options.--fx-stack-left: look: stack, left offset of the b cell, default 0. Set a’s parent to position: relative
options.[data-fx-part=a] · [data-fx-part=b]: Photo slot — placeholder where the first child inside gets cropped
options.[data-fx-part=button]: Toggle button (optional) — the first child is a rotating dotted circle, the child inside it is a symbol rotating in reverse

note: When the parent is flex, spaces between words disappear, so --fx-rest-gap leaves a margin in the collapsed gap. Reduced motion doesn’t switch on its own, it takes effect immediately when toggled
